title: fix(codex): show late thread titles, and stop refetching the world to find one row
context:
Two things made a fresh Codex session look far slower than it was.

The title arrives asynchronously: thread/name/set lands seconds after the
spawn returns and writes to ~/.codex/state_*.sqlite. That DB is excluded
from the archive corpus signature on purpose, since it is WAL and its
mtime moves on every write from any live session, so gating an
O(all-rows) rebuild on it would pin the CPU. The cost was a row stuck at
"(untitled)" until something unrelated invalidated the cache. Treat the
title a
